App.name: Kisan Vakil
App.tagline: Your partner for land, law, schemes, and rights.

Landing.headline: Land. Law. Rights.
Landing.subheadline: Plain-language help for land records, schemes, notices, complaints, and documents in one place.
Landing.feature1Body: View khata, khasra, mutation, and ownership history in one place.
Landing.feature2Body: Check eligibility for subsidies, loans, and relief fast.
Landing.feature3Body: Keep legal notices, complaints, and paperwork organized.

Dashboard.title: Kisan Vakil
Dashboard.subtitle: Land, schemes, notices, and documents in one place.
Dashboard.openProfileHint: Open your profile to set language, village, tehsil, and other details.
Dashboard.landLookupBody: Ready for khata, khasra, mutation, and ownership history.
Dashboard.schemeBody: Quick checks for subsidies, loans, and relief programs.
Dashboard.noticeBody: Draft complaints, applications, or legal notices.
Dashboard.vaultBody: Store land papers, IDs, and notices safely.

Laws.title: Law search
Laws.subtitle: Search acts and rules that affect you — plain language + official links.
Laws.placeholderNL: Example: Someone is making me sign land papers — what should I check?
Laws.nlNote: You can type in your own words.
Laws.voiceNotSupported: Voice input is not supported on this device/browser.
Laws.empty: No laws matched. Try fewer words.
Laws.officialHint: Open the full law / government source.
Laws.askSubtitle: Ask about this law or your selected line.
Laws.askAboutLawPrompt: Explain this law for a farmer and what I should do next.
Laws.askSelectionPrompt: Explain the selected line in simple words and tell me what to do.
Laws.askEmpty: Ask a question to get a response.
Laws.followUpPlaceholder: Example: Can I sell this land to a non-farmer? What permission is needed?

Profile.title: Farmer profile
Profile.description: Keep this accurate so forms, notices, and applications stay simple.
Profile.basicDetailsBody: Use the same name and number that appear on your paperwork.
Profile.overviewBody: A quick view of what this profile already powers.
Profile.documentsBody: Stored papers, notices, IDs, and receipts.
Profile.landParcelsBody: Land records, khata, khasra, and ownership data.
Profile.latestParcelBody: The most recently updated land record context.
Profile.latestParcelEmpty: Add a land parcel to see khata and khasra details here.
Profile.latestDocumentBody: The newest file in your vault.
Profile.latestDocumentEmpty: Upload a document to see it here.
Profile.locationBody: These defaults help with land records and local forms.
Profile.locationDefaultsBody: Shown on drafts, notices, and lookup forms.
Profile.preferencesBody: Choose how the app should talk to you and what kind of help you need most.
Profile.supportNeedHint: Choose the area you want surfaced first.
Profile.phoneTip: Tip: leave phone blank if you do not want to store it.
Profile.voiceTip: Voice summaries and dialect tuning can be added later.

AuthShell.title: Understand the paper before you sign it.
AuthShell.description: Kisan Vakil helps farmers check land records, schemes, notices, and document drafts in plain language. Built for low-friction, trust-first work.
AuthShell.item1Body: Khata, khasra, mutation, and ownership history in one place.
AuthShell.item2Body: Check eligibility, draft complaints, and keep templates ready.
AuthShell.item3Body: OTP, passkeys, and family help without losing control.

AuthSignIn.title: Welcome back
AuthSignIn.description: Sign in to check land records, schemes, notice drafts, and your saved documents.
AuthSignIn.helpReset: If you have forgotten your password, use the reset link.
AuthSignIn.helpPasskey: Passkeys work only if you have registered one on this device.

AuthSignUp.title: Create your Kisan Vakil account
AuthSignUp.description: Start with email and password. You can add passkeys and two-factor authentication later.
AuthSignUp.profileImageHint: Optional. Helps family or an agent recognize the account.
AuthSignUp.avatarTooLarge: Profile image must be 2MB or smaller.
AuthSignUp.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
AuthSignUp.imageUploadFailed: Account created, but the profile image upload failed.

AuthForgotPassword.title: Forgot password
AuthForgotPassword.description: Enter the email address you used when you joined and we'll send you instructions to reset your password.
AuthForgotPassword.sendFailed: Unable to send a reset link right now. Please try again in a moment.
AuthForgotPassword.submittedDescription: If the address exists, a reset link has been sent to {email}.
AuthForgotPassword.requestedDescription: Check your inbox and spam folder. The link expires for security and should only be used on a trusted device.
AuthForgotPassword.securityDescription: We do not email passwords. This flow only sends a temporary reset link if the account exists.

AuthResetPassword.title: Reset password
AuthResetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.
AuthResetPassword.invalidLinkDescription: This reset link is invalid or expired. Please request a new one.
AuthResetPassword.missingTokenDescription: Open the reset link from your email to continue.
AuthResetPassword.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

AuthTwoFactor.title: Two-factor verification
AuthTwoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code to finish signing in.
AuthTwoFactor.enterCode: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
AuthTwoFactor.footer: If you can't access your authenticator, you may need backup codes.

Chat.title: Kisan Vakil
Chat.description: Plain-language help for land records, schemes, notices, complaints, and documents.
Chat.emptyState: Ask about khata, khasra, mutation, scheme eligibility, a notice you received, or paste a clause you're unsure about.
Chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Chat.placeholder: Ask in Hindi, Marathi, or simple English…
Chat.note: Don't sign anything you don't understand. If you share personal docs, redact Aadhaar, phone, or account details where possible.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.description: Need a hand with signing in? Reach us and we'll get you sorted.
Contact.body: For now, the fastest way is to open an issue or message the team.
